digest_rule: digest is null unless a SHA-256 was actually computed and verified in this run; unknown digests are never invented. version is null wherever no producer-published version exists.
evidence_rule: evidence_state is the three-state verdict for this row's own evidence: PASS only with executed evidence in this run, FAIL never downgraded, NOT_VERIFIED with the exact missing item in gap. readiness is NOT an evidence verdict and never upgrades because a name exists.
ledger_scope: A's external edges only: every row has A as producer or consumer, one artifact per row. B owns the aggregate runtime/dependencies.json (Plan A Q08/R2-06); A submits these rows to it and never claims the total ledger. Whole B/C tasks are not modeled as one readiness bit.
phase_registry_gap: B01 has not published the (owner, scenario, phase, run_id) registry or acceptance-result.schema.json. The phases used here (main, da-evidence, experience:nmr, experience:thermo, experience:selectivity) come from Plan B B01's declared enum and the R6 section 3.2 static combination check only - they are plan-declared, not registry-verified. If B01 registers different values, the registry wins and A re-points these rows before any receipt is written. No run_id is known anywhere in this ledger.
phase_semantics: phase = the registered B01 phase under which this artifact's evidence is keyed when the edge closes, derived from the producer's scenario scope (B00/B01/B05/B08/B25a => main; frozen DA run-spec and the DA execution/search chain => da-evidence; the cross-domain-live namespaces => experience:nmr / experience:thermo / experience:selectivity). Bare fixture/live values are deliberately not used (Plan A verification strategy).
readiness_semantics: Ladder contract_ready < implementation_ready < integration_ready < verified. contract_ready = the edge's contract (artifact identity, producer, consumer, phase, fields) is specified by the plans/registers; it does NOT mean the file exists. implementation_ready = the artifact was delivered by its producer. integration_ready = the consumer integrated the exported artifact (this is the delivered-state readiness of the B23b edge per A-25b todo 46). verified = the consumer holds evidence for this artifact (evidence_state PASS). evidence_state is a separate three-state field; readiness never implies verification.
